newsitem.title: USA: Florida House approves audit notification bill.
newsitem.headline: Florida House approves audit notification bill.

text.p: The Florida House of Representatives has approved a bill requiring independent auditors to notify every elected member of a municipal governing board when they find evidence that the municipality has financial problems.
The bill's sponsor, Rep. Lee Constantine, R-Altamonte Springs, said the proposal was prompted by Miami city commissioners' claim last fall that they did not know the city had a $68 million deficit.
The city's outside auditors had warned in an annnual report that Miami was facing serious problems but the commissioners said they never saw the report.

The bill (HB685) also gives the state auditor general the power to request information beyond the scope of the annual report from a city that it believes may have financial problems. It was approved Wednesday and now goes to the Seanate.
